question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing striker, Bob is playing right back, Claire is playing left midfielder, Dave is playing right winger, and Eve is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Claire and Bob trade positions. Then, Dave and Eve trade positions. Finally, Eve and Claire trade positions. At the end of the match, Bob is playing
Options:
(A) striker
(B) right back
(C) left midfielder
(D) right winger
(E) left winger
solution:
Positions are listed in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve.
Initial: striker, right back, left midfielder, right winger, left winger
1. Alice and Claire swap: left midfielder, right back, striker, right winger, left winger
2. Claire and Bob swap: left midfielder, striker, right back, right winger, left winger
3. Claire and Bob swap again: left midfielder, right back, striker, right winger, left winger
4. Dave and Eve swap: left midfielder, right back, striker, left winger, right winger
5. Eve and Claire swap: left midfielder, right back, right winger, left winger, striker
Bob is playing right back, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
